Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The analyzed material is the erythrocyte cytosol (cytoplasmic proteome) after hemoglobin depletion. While Ni-NTA columns were used for depletion, this was a removal of a high-abundance contaminant (hemoglobin) to enable analysis of the remaining cytosolic subproteome, rather than an affinity-purification of a specific protein complex. Therefore, it is classified as a subproteome (organelle-enriched/cytosolic scope).
